title: Let a later accepted task supersede a shared-file artifact of an earlier done task
description: harness.py check fails whenever an integration file (e.g. ai_harness/DECISIONS.md) is legitimately updated by a later task (COORD-003) because the earlier done task (COORD-001) still pins the old hash. Found by REVIEW-003/004/005 reviewers on 2026-11-25. Change check(): for each artifact path, only the review/done task with the most recent submit event must match the file; earlier holders of the same path are reported as 'superseded' instead of failing. Add a unit test; all existing tests must pass.
acceptance: check passes when a later submitted task re-registers a shared file, and lists the superseded path
check still fails if the latest holder's file is changed after submission
All tests pass under py and the ai360 Python
